"""Mechanical offline corruption controls for the sealed dependency evidence packet."""
import copy, hashlib, json, os, subprocess, sys
from pathlib import Path

PYTHON='/opt/homebrew/opt/python@3.13/libexec/bin/python3'
REPO=Path('/Users/dylan/.codex/worktrees/dependency-compatibility-batch/shardloom-local-repo')
PACKET=REPO/'docs/benchmarks/evidence/dependency-followup-2026-11-06'
VERIFY=PACKET/'verify.py'
ARCHIVE=PACKET/'verification.tar.xz'
OUT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
TARGETS=[PACKET/'acceptance.json',VERIFY,ARCHIVE]
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def run(label,packet):
 cmd=[PYTHON,'-B',str(VERIFY),'--packet',str(packet)]
 try:
  r=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=REPO,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=30)
  result={'label':label,'command':cmd,'exit_code':r.returncode,'stdout':r.stdout,'stderr':r.stderr,'timed_out':False}
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:
  result={'label':label,'command':cmd,'exit_code':None,'stdout':e.stdout or '', 'stderr':e.stderr or '', 'timed_out':True}
 return result
before={str(p):sha(p) for p in TARGETS}
results=[run('baseline',PACKET)]
mutations=[
 ('remove_last_check',lambda x:x['checks'].pop()),
 ('increment_python_core_reported_test_runs',lambda x:x['python_core'].__setitem__('reported_test_runs',x['python_core']['reported_test_runs']+1)),
 ('set_installed_package_skipped_to_one',lambda x:x['installed_package'].__setitem__('skipped',1)),
 ('increment_cargo_lock_snapshot_bytes',lambda x:x['code_snapshot']['Cargo.lock'].__setitem__('bytes',x['code_snapshot']['Cargo.lock']['bytes']+1)),
 ('replace_archive_sha256_with_zeroes',lambda x:x.__setitem__('archive_sha256','0'*64)),
]
for name,mutate in mutations:
 fixture=OUT/name
 fixture.mkdir()
 report=copy.deepcopy(json.loads((PACKET/'acceptance.json').read_bytes()))
 mutate(report)
 (fixture/'acceptance.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
 (fixture/'verification.tar.xz').symlink_to(ARCHIVE)
 results.append(run(name,fixture))
after={str(p):sha(p) for p in TARGETS}
for row in results:
 prefix=OUT/row['label']
 Path(str(prefix)+'.stdout.txt').write_text(row['stdout'])
 Path(str(prefix)+'.stderr.txt').write_text(row['stderr'])
# suffix handling yields e.g. baseline.stdout.txt and baseline.stderr.txt
expected=[]
for row in results[1:]:
 expected.append(row['exit_code'] not in (None,0) and not row['timed_out'] and 'AssertionError' in row['stderr'] and 'FileNotFoundError' not in row['stderr'] and 'TimeoutExpired' not in row['stderr'])
status=(results[0]['exit_code']==0 and not results[0]['timed_out'] and all(expected) and before==after)
receipt={'status':'COMPLETE' if status else 'NEEDS_REASONING','python':PYTHON,'python_version':subprocess.run([PYTHON,'--version'],text=True,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout.strip(),'repo':str(REPO),'packet':str(PACKET),'verifier_command':[PYTHON,'-B',str(VERIFY),'--packet',str(PACKET)],'fixture_command_template':[PYTHON,'-B',str(VERIFY),'--packet','<fixture-directory>'],'timeout_seconds':30,'original_hashes_before':before,'original_hashes_after':after,'original_hashes_unchanged':before==after,'baseline_and_controls':results,'all_controls_assertion_failures':all(expected),'notes':'Each fixture contains only a deep-copied acceptance.json and a symlink to the original verification.tar.xz; the verifier script is invoked from its untouched packet path.'}
(OUT/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in receipt.items() if k!='baseline_and_controls'},indent=2))
for row in results: print(json.dumps({k:row[k] for k in ('label','exit_code','timed_out')}))
if not status: raise SystemExit(1)

"""Verify exact corruption fixtures and preserve their compact observation."""
import copy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CONTROL = OUT / 'packet-controls-r1'
PACKET = Path('/Users/dylan/.codex/worktrees/dependency-compatibility-batch/shardloom-local-repo/docs/benchmarks/evidence/dependency-followup-2026-11-06')
original = json.loads((PACKET / 'acceptance.json').read_bytes())
receipt = json.loads((CONTROL / 'receipt.json').read_bytes())
assert receipt['status'] == 'COMPLETE' and receipt['original_hashes_unchanged']
assert receipt['original_hashes_before'] == receipt['original_hashes_after']
for path, digest in receipt['original_hashes_before'].items():
    assert Path(path).parent == PACKET
    assert hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
mutations = [
    ('remove_last_check', lambda value: value['checks'].pop()),
    ('increment_python_core_reported_test_runs', lambda value: value['python_core'].__setitem__('reported_test_runs', value['python_core']['reported_test_runs'] + 1)),
    ('set_installed_package_skipped_to_one', lambda value: value['installed_package'].__setitem__('skipped', 1)),
    ('increment_cargo_lock_snapshot_bytes', lambda value: value['code_snapshot']['Cargo.lock'].__setitem__('bytes', value['code_snapshot']['Cargo.lock']['bytes'] + 1)),
    ('replace_archive_sha256_with_zeroes', lambda value: value.__setitem__('archive_sha256', '0' * 64)),
]
rows = receipt['baseline_and_controls']
assert len(rows) == 6 and rows[0]['label'] == 'baseline' and rows[0]['exit_code'] == 0
assert json.loads(rows[0]['stdout'])['status'] == 'passed'
for row in rows:
    assert row['timed_out'] is False
    assert (CONTROL / (row['label'] + '.stdout.txt')).read_text() == row['stdout']
    assert (CONTROL / (row['label'] + '.stderr.txt')).read_text() == row['stderr']
for (name, mutate), row in zip(mutations, rows[1:]):
    expected = copy.deepcopy(original)
    mutate(expected)
    fixture = CONTROL / name
    assert json.loads((fixture / 'acceptance.json').read_bytes()) == expected
    assert (fixture / 'verification.tar.xz').is_symlink()
    assert (fixture / 'verification.tar.xz').resolve() == PACKET / 'verification.tar.xz'
    assert row['label'] == name and row['exit_code'] == 1
    assert row['stderr'].endswith('AssertionError\n')
    assert row['command'] == [receipt['python'], '-B', str(PACKET / 'verify.py'), '--packet', str(fixture)]
driver = (CONTROL / 'control_driver.py').read_text()
report = dict(status='passed', baseline_passed=True, rejected_controls=5,
    exact_fixture_mutations_verified=True, original_packet_unchanged=True,
    observation=receipt, driver_source=driver,
    driver_sha256=hashlib.sha256(driver.encode()).hexdigest(),
    primary_verifier_source=Path(__file__).read_text(),
    scope='Saved evidence consistency controls only; no engine execution, benchmark, build or installation.')
with (PACKET / 'corruption-controls.json').open('x') as stream:
    json.dump(report, stream, indent=2)
    stream.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({key: report[key] for key in ('status', 'baseline_passed', 'rejected_controls', 'original_packet_unchanged')}))
